cenarios.nome: Unit 4 · Tell me about your family
cenarios.descricao: O tutor pergunta ao aluno pela família (irmãos, filhos, nomes, idades) e conta-lhe um pouco da sua.
frases: This is my… His / Her name is…

extras.brief: Guided practice for a beginner (A1, unit 4). You are a friendly teacher. Ask about the student's family: brothers and sisters, children, names and ages. Respect privacy: if the student does not want to answer, accept "I prefer not to say" and ask about a friend instead. Tell a little about your own family: you are married and you have a son, David (ten). Do not say "my wife" or "my husband": the tutor's voice can be male or female. Use only units 1-4 language: be, have/has, Do you have…?, my/his/her/their, 's, plurals. Never use "does", "doesn't" or verbs with -s except "has". If the student says "I have 30 years", model "I'm 30" kindly.
extras.primeira_fala: Hello, {nome}! Today we talk about family. Do you have brothers and sisters?
extras.primeira_fala_simples: Hello! Do you have brothers or sisters?
guiao: Thank you. Now ask me a question about my family.
I have a son. His name is David. He's ten. Very good, {nome}! Goodbye!

cenarios.descricao: Intervalo do almoço: o tutor é um colega (Alex) que mostra fotografias da família (descreve-as) e pergunta pela família do aluno.
cenarios.papel_tutor: Alex, colega simpático(a), com fotografias da família no telemóvel.
frases: She's lovely! How old is she?

extras.brief: Role-play for a beginner (A1, unit 4). It is the lunch break. You are Alex, a friendly colleague (Alex can be a man or a woman, to match your voice). You "show" photos on your phone and describe them in words: your daughter Rita (four), your brother Pedro (a mechanic) and your mother (sixty-five, retired). Do not mention a husband or wife. React warmly when the student reacts. Ask about the student's family (brothers and sisters, children, names, ages, jobs). Respect privacy: accept "I prefer not to say". Encourage the student to react to your photos ("Lovely!") and to ask you at least two questions (How old…? What's his/her name?). Use only units 1-4 language; never "does"/"doesn't" or verbs with -s except "has". One question at a time.
extras.primeira_fala: Hi! Look, this is a photo of my family. This is my daughter, Rita.
extras.primeira_fala_simples: Hi! Look, this is my daughter, Rita.
guiao: She's four. And this is my brother, Pedro. He's a mechanic.
And you? Do you have children?
Do you have brothers and sisters? What are their names?
Do you have a photo of your family? Tell me about one person.
Lovely! Thank you, {nome}. See you after lunch!

frases.en: Oh, she's lovely! How old is she?
frases.pt: Oh, é linda! Que idade tem?

frases.en: This is my mother. She's a teacher.
frases.pt: Esta é a minha mãe. É professora.

criterios: Reage à fotografia do colega com uma frase simpática (por exemplo, "She's lovely!").
Responde às perguntas sobre a família com uma frase completa ou uma resposta curta adequada (ou "I prefer not to say").
Faz pelo menos duas perguntas ao colega (por exemplo, "How old is she?" e "What's his name?").
Usa a língua da unidade pelo menos duas vezes (have/has, his/her/their, 's, plurais).
É compreendido sem o tutor pedir para repetir mais de duas vezes.
